name: New York City adopted rules and historical Code and Charter snapshots
coverage: 462 adopted-rule instruments, 6,106 Administrative Code sections and 627 Charter sections in historical 2017 source snapshots
record_note: Rules are separate adopted instruments, not a consolidated RCNY. The Administrative Code and Charter texts are unofficial historical snapshots labelled text as of 2017-04-22; their exact legal currency and latest included Local Law are unknown. The record_to day applies to the adopted-rule collection only.
